sourcePolicy: Manual transcription of numeric chart labels from primary laboratory reviews. No recurring scraper or claimed open-data license. Local evidence images are for private verification only.
datePolicy: Review publication/update dates are retained separately. Exact measurement days are not published; measuredAt remains null. GN row tags are retained verbatim as chart_row_tag conditions; their date meaning is not independently established and no measurement date is inferred.
comparisonPolicy: Compare only identical review cohort, declared comparison scope, workload and conditions. Published platform-comparison cohorts retain the explicitly different test platforms; unrelated platform-specific contexts are not joined. Unpublished details are explicitly unknown and must not join unrelated reviews. Rendering scores do not predict gaming FPS. The GN F1 24 CPU and Starfield GPU FPS results each describe only their separate published chart cohort, not another game, a guaranteed store AIB/SKU or a complete build. Benchmark measurements are not used for automatic build selection.
